# The accessibility tree reports the bottom buttons at 0,0, so taps by label miss. Dump the raw tree to see why.
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 10
sh uiautomator dump /sdcard/u.xml >/dev/null; sed 's/<node/\n<node/g' /sdcard/u.xml
sh dumpsys activity top | grep -iE "mVisibleRect|Insets|navigationBars|getVisibleDisplayFrame|mAttachInfo" | head -20
